description: Classification of all 1757 TA (Transportation/Traffic) checklist items by distance-measurement applicability. Covers all 43 TA guide files.

categories.horizontal: Requires plan-view distance measurement — tool CAN measure
categories.not-applicable: Non-distance check (documentation, material, methodology, approval, calculation)
categories.vertical-or-mixed: Requires vertical/3D clearance — tool CANNOT fully measure (yet)

subClassifications.distance-only: Distance measurement alone can resolve the verdict (compare measured value to threshold)
subClassifications.distance-plus: Distance measurement needed but verdict also requires additional information (see additionalRequirements)

additionalRequirementTypes.street-level-verification: ASMP Street Level classification must be verified from external database

additionalRequirementTypes.land-use-verification: Land use type must be verified (residential, commercial, industrial, etc.)
additionalRequirementTypes.approval-verification: Director, engineer, or other official approval must be documented
additionalRequirementTypes.design-vehicle-verification: Design vehicle type must be confirmed (WB-62, WB-40, SU-40, etc.)
additionalRequirementTypes.driveway-type-verification: Driveway type (Type I/II/III) must be confirmed
